results.ask: I want to do a bonfire at the beach Saturday
results.expect: includes plover season status and fire rules with sources, unprompted; cites
results.answer:
Bonfires on Ocean Beach aren't allowed right now. The winter no-burn season runs November 1 through February 28 to avoid Bay Area Spare the Air days, so this Saturday falls inside it. The NPS [Ocean Beach fire rules](https://www.nps.gov/goga/learn/management/fire_beachfireregs.htm) say fires are allowed only in the provided rings between Stairwells 15 and 20, and only outside the no-burn season.

If you're planning a beach gathering, the snowy plover season is also on through May 15, so dogs need a six-foot leash in the protection area on the southern stretch ([NPS](https://www.nps.gov/goga/planyourvisit/oceanbeach.htm)).

To ask about the rules, contact Golden Gate National Recreation Area (NPS), which manages the beach. For a beach cleanup or other ways to help the shore, [Surfrider San Francisco](https://sf.surfrider.org/) runs them.

results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, 0.2 miles from Ocean Beach. Most homes went up around 1941, per the [SF Assessor-Recorder's 2023 roll](https://data.sf.gov/) via the block notes.

- **Right near you:** OpenSFHistory pins two old photos about 250 feet north, at 46th and Moraga: [wnp58.929](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.929.jpg) and [wnp58.923](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.923.jpg), credited to the Western Neighborhoods Project.
- **Two blocks west:** The Noriega seawall, from the 1980s, where wind piles sand over the promenade each year ([SPUR](https://www.spur.org/sites/default/files/2013-10/OB_open%20house_ALL%20BOARDS_Part6.pdf)).
- **About a third of a mile southwest:** The clipper ship King Philip, wrecked in 1878, whose lower hull is still buried near Noriega and Ortega ([NPS](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm)).

Street cleaning: the east side is Mon 1st and 3rd, noon to 2pm (next Nov 16). The west side is Thu 1st, 3rd, and 5th, noon to 2pm (next Nov 19). Source: [SF street sweeping schedule](https://data.sf.gov/d/yhqp-riqs). The posted signs are the last word.

If you know your block's history, I can add it to the notes for the next neighbor.
